import argparse
import functools
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import threading
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))
from revenue_lab.bundle import ROOT, write_json
from revenue_lab.site import build
from capture_presentation import CONTRAST, Quiet

AXE_HASH="880970c081707360e64f34cea25ff91892f5bc95675b0776925b9709dd8a68bb"
STAGES=["discrepancy","lineage","delivery","recovery","architecture"]


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output",type=Path,default=ROOT/"docs/evidence/revenue-integrity/browser.json")
    parser.add_argument("--images",type=Path,default=ROOT/"docs/images/revenue-integrity")
    args=parser.parse_args();build();args.images.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    axe=ROOT/".cache/research-axe.min.js"
    if not axe.exists():
        with urllib.request.urlopen("https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/axe-core/4.10.3/axe.min.js",timeout=40) as response:axe.write_bytes(response.read())
    assert hashlib.sha256(axe.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==AXE_HASH

    class Pages(Quiet):
        def translate_path(self,path):
            prefix="/enterprise-revenue-systems-lab/"
            return super().translate_path(path.removeprefix(prefix) if path.startswith(prefix) else "/not-found")

    server=ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),functools.partial(Pages,directory=str(ROOT/"dist")))
    thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
    base=f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/enterprise-revenue-systems-lab/"
    errors,outside,writes,layouts,accessibility,images=[],[],[],[],[],{}
    try:
        with sync_playwright() as pw:
            browser=pw.chromium.launch();page=browser.new_page(viewport={"width":1440,"height":1100},device_scale_factor=1,reduced_motion="reduce")
            page.on("pageerror",lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
            page.on("request",lambda r:outside.append(r.url) if not r.url.startswith(base) else None)
            page.on("request",lambda r:writes.append(r.url) if r.method!="GET" else None)
            page.goto(base+"?case=revenue-integrity")
            page.get_by_role("heading",name="Which number should Finance trust?").wait_for()
            page.get_by_role("button",name="Validate artifact integrity").click()
            page.locator("#status").filter(has_text="Artifact integrity verified").wait_for()
            page.add_script_tag(content=axe.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            for width in [1440,1024,768,390,320]:
                page.set_viewport_size({"width":width,"height":1100 if width>768 else 844})
                for stage in STAGES:
                    page.locator(f'[data-integrity-stage="{stage}"]').click()
                    layouts.append({"width":width,"state":stage,"overflow":page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth"),"contrast":page.evaluate(CONTRAST)})
                    if width in [1440,390]:
                        result=page.evaluate("async()=>{const r=await axe.run(document,{runOnly:{type:'tag',values:['wcag2a','wcag2aa','wcag21aa']}});return {violations:r.violations,incomplete:r.incomplete.map(x=>({id:x.id,impact:x.impact})),passes:r.passes.length}}")
                        accessibility.append({"width":width,"state":stage,**result})
                for tab in ["Source records","Evidence timeline","Compare & verify"]:
                    page.get_by_role("tab",name=tab,exact=True).click()
                    layouts.append({"width":width,"tab":tab,"overflow":page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth"),"contrast":page.evaluate(CONTRAST)})
                page.get_by_role("tab",name="Decision & outcome",exact=True).click()
            page.set_viewport_size({"width":1440,"height":1260});page.locator('[data-integrity-stage="discrepancy"]').click()
            page.evaluate("scrollTo(0,document.querySelector('.release-hero').getBoundingClientRect().top+scrollY-20)")
            page.screenshot(path=str(args.images/"revenue-integrity-desktop.png"));images["revenue-integrity-desktop.png"]={"width":1440,"height":1260,"capture":"actual viewport; recorded financial comparison and unresolved variance"}
            page.locator('[data-integrity-stage="recovery"]').click()
            page.evaluate("scrollTo(0,document.querySelector('.release-stages').getBoundingClientRect().top+scrollY-25)")
            page.screenshot(path=str(args.images/"revenue-integrity-recovery.png"));images["revenue-integrity-recovery.png"]={"width":1440,"height":1260,"capture":"actual viewport; separate operator recovery outcome and unchanged variance"}
            page.set_viewport_size({"width":390,"height":1000})
            page.evaluate("scrollTo(0,document.querySelector('.release-stages').getBoundingClientRect().top+scrollY-15)")
            page.screenshot(path=str(args.images/"revenue-integrity-mobile.png"));images["revenue-integrity-mobile.png"]={"width":390,"height":1000,"capture":"actual mobile viewport; selectable financial investigation stages"}
            browser_version=browser.version;browser.close()
    finally:
        server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join()
    report={"captured_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"browser":"Chromium "+browser_version,
            "served":"actual dist at /enterprise-revenue-systems-lab/; not a public deployment", "case":"revenue-integrity",
            "source_revision":"e2993099acaaae188aac0d83ba840cecef1c0014",
            "source_sha256":{name:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ["web/app.js","web/integrity.js","web/style.css","web/index.html","web/catalog.json","sources.lock.json","scripts/capture_integrity.py"]},
            "image_sha256":{name:hashlib.sha256((args.images/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in images},"images":images,
            "layouts":layouts,"accessibility":accessibility,"axe_version":"4.10.3","axe_sha256":AXE_HASH,
            "page_errors":errors,"nonlocal_requests":outside,"http_writes":writes,"new_model_execution":False,"new_financial_effects":False}
    write_json(args.output,report)
    assert not errors and not outside and not writes
    assert all(not r["overflow"] and not r["contrast"]["failures"] for r in layouts), "layout/contrast failure"
    assert all(not r["violations"] for r in accessibility), "automated accessibility failure"
    print(json.dumps({"layout_checks":len(layouts),"accessibility_states":len(accessibility),"screenshots":len(images),"status":"passed"}))


if __name__=="__main__":main()

"""Review/capture the static explorer using existing recorded evidence only."""

import argparse
import functools
import hashlib
import json
import threading
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CASES = {
    "integrity": "revenue-integrity",
    "release": "release-assurance",
    "seller": "seller-application",
    "control": "control-recovery",
    "revenue": "revenue-correction",
    "connected": "connected-roundtrip",
    "gtm": "gtm-enterprise",
}
TABS = ["Decision & outcome", "Source records", "Evidence timeline", "Compare & verify"]

# Rendered text on solid backgrounds; not a complete accessibility audit.
CONTRAST = """() => {
  const rgba = s => (s.match(/[\\d.]+/g) || []).map(Number);
  const over = (a,b) => { const t = a[3] ?? 1; return [0,1,2].map(i=>a[i]*t+b[i]*(1-t)); };
  const lum = c => c.map(x=>x/255).map(x=>x<=.04045?x/12.92:((x+.055)/1.055)**2.4)
    .reduce((s,x,i)=>s+x*[.2126,.7152,.0722][i],0);
  const failures=[], walker=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
  let node, checked=0, minimum=100;
  while(node=walker.nextNode()) {
    if(!/[a-z0-9]/i.test(node.textContent)) continue;
    const e=node.parentElement, s=getComputedStyle(e), r=e.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(!r.width||!r.height||s.visibility==='hidden'||s.display==='none'||e.closest('script,style,option')) continue;
    const parents=[]; for(let p=e;p;p=p.parentElement) parents.unshift(p);
    let bg=[255,255,255]; for(const p of parents) bg=over(rgba(getComputedStyle(p).backgroundColor),bg);
    const fg=over(rgba(s.color),bg), a=lum(fg), b=lum(bg), ratio=(Math.max(a,b)+.05)/(Math.min(a,b)+.05);
    const size=parseFloat(s.fontSize), large=size>=24||(size>=18.66&&parseInt(s.fontWeight)>=700);
    const threshold=large?3:4.5; checked++; minimum=Math.min(minimum,ratio);
    if(ratio+.001<threshold) failures.push({text:node.textContent.trim().slice(0,100),selector:e.id||e.className||e.tagName,ratio:+ratio.toFixed(3),threshold});
  }
  return {checked,minimum_ratio:+minimum.toFixed(3),failures};
}"""


class Quiet(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *_):
        pass


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--investigation", choices=CASES, help="Capture only one investigation; default reviews all")
    parser.add_argument("--images", type=Path, default=ROOT / ".cache/visual-review")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--evidence", type=Path, default=ROOT / ".cache/visual-review/capture.json"
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    # Generate only the new recorded case archive. Existing source-bound ZIPs
    # must not be rebuilt by a visual review.
    bundle_dir = ROOT / "web/evidence/connected-roundtrip"
    bundle = json.loads((bundle_dir / "bundle.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    with zipfile.ZipFile(bundle_dir / "reproduction.zip", "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        def member(name, data):
            info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, date_time=(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
            info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
            z.writestr(info, data)

        member("bundle.json", (bundle_dir / "bundle.json").read_bytes())
        for item in bundle["artifacts"]:
            member(item["path"], (bundle_dir / item["path"]).read_bytes())
        member(
            "REPRODUCE.txt",
            (
                "Clone https://github.com/rlbsem/enterprise-revenue-systems-lab\\n"
                "Install requirements.lock and set PYTHONPATH=src.\\n"
                + "\\n".join(bundle["reproduce"])
                + "\\npython -m revenue_lab.cli verify <extracted-bundle>\\n"
                "Recorded vendor execution is verified offline; no new vendor calls.\\n"
            ).encode(),
        )
    args.images.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.evidence.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(
        ("127.0.0.1", 0), functools.partial(Quiet, directory=str(ROOT / "web"))
    )
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/"
    catalog = json.loads((ROOT / "web/catalog.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if args.investigation:
        catalog["scenarios"] = [c for c in catalog["scenarios"] if c["investigation"] == args.investigation]
    errors, requests, reviews, images = [], [], [], {}
    try:
        with sync_playwright() as pw:
            browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
            browser_version = browser.version
            context = browser.new_context(
                viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 1000},
                device_scale_factor=1,
                locale="en-CA",
                reduced_motion="reduce",
            )
            page = context.new_page()
            page.on("pageerror", lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
            page.on(
                "request",
                lambda request: requests.append((request.method, request.url)),
            )
            for width, height in [
                (1440, 1000),
                (1280, 900),
                (768, 1024),
                (390, 844),
                (320, 740),
            ]:
                page.set_viewport_size({"width": width, "height": height})
                for case in catalog["scenarios"]:
                    investigation, scenario = case["investigation"], case["id"]
                    page.goto(url + "?case=" + scenario)
                    page.get_by_role(
                        "heading", name=case["title"], exact=True
                    ).wait_for()
                    page.get_by_role(
                        "button", name="Validate artifact integrity"
                    ).click()
                    page.locator("#status").filter(
                        has_text="Artifact integrity verified"
                    ).wait_for()
                    for tab in TABS:
                        page.get_by_role("tab", name=tab, exact=True).click()
                        assert page.locator("#panel").inner_text().strip()
                        reviews.append(
                            {
                                "case": scenario,
                                "width": width,
                                "view": tab,
                                "overflow": page.evaluate(
                                    "document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth"
                                ),
                                "contrast": page.evaluate(CONTRAST),
                            }
                        )
                    page.get_by_role("tab", name=TABS[0], exact=True).click()
                    page.evaluate("scrollTo(0,0)")
                    if width in (1440, 390) and (scenario == CASES[investigation] or investigation == "gtm"):
                        suffix = "overview" if width == 1440 else "mobile"
                        image_name = scenario if investigation == "gtm" else investigation
                        image = args.images / f"{image_name}-{suffix}.png"
                        if width == 390:
                            image = args.images / "visual-refresh" / image.name
                        image.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        page.screenshot(path=str(image), full_page=True)
                        images[image.relative_to(args.images).as_posix()] = {
                            "sha256": digest(image),
                            "case": scenario,
                            "viewport": {"width": width, "height": height},
                            "full_page": True,
                        }
                        if width == 390:
                            preview = (
                                ROOT
                                / ".cache/visual-review"
                                / f"{investigation}-mobile-viewport.png"
                            )
                            preview.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                            page.screenshot(path=str(preview))
                            page.locator(".case").scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                            page.screenshot(
                                path=str(
                                    preview.with_name(
                                        f"{investigation}-mobile-panel.png"
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                    page.get_by_role("tab", name=TABS[0], exact=True).focus()
                    page.keyboard.press("ArrowRight")
                    assert (
                        page.get_by_role("tab", name=TABS[1], exact=True).get_attribute(
                            "aria-selected"
                        )
                        == "true"
                    )
                    assert (
                        page.evaluate(
                            "getComputedStyle(document.activeElement).outlineStyle"
                        )
                        != "none"
                    )
                    expected_label = (
                        "Verify this recorded financial scenario offline"
                        if investigation == "integrity" else
                        "Verify this recorded release offline"
                        if investigation == "release" else
                        "Verify these separate records offline"
                        if investigation == "gtm" else
                        "Verify this native record offline"
                        if investigation == "connected"
                        else "Reproduce this investigation · fresh local execution"
                    )
                    page.get_by_text(expected_label, exact=True).click()
                    assert page.locator("#fresh").is_hidden()
                    assert page.locator("#commands").inner_text().strip()
                    if width == 1440:
                        with page.expect_download() as event:
                            page.get_by_role(
                                "link", name="Download reproduction ZIP"
                            ).click()
                        saved = ROOT / ".cache/visual-review" / f"{scenario}.zip"
                        saved.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        event.value.save_as(saved)
                        assert digest(saved) == digest(
                            ROOT / "web/evidence" / scenario / "reproduction.zip"
                        )
                        with zipfile.ZipFile(saved) as archive:
                            assert archive.testzip() is None
            # A real invalid import exercises the existing visible refusal state.
            page.set_viewport_size({"width": 390, "height": 844})
            page.get_by_text(
                "Validate a downloaded portable bundle", exact=True
            ).click()
            page.get_by_label("Portable evidence JSON").set_input_files(
                {
                    "name": "invalid.json",
                    "mimeType": "application/json",
                    "buffer": b"{}",
                }
            )
            page.locator("#status.error").filter(has_text="Import refused").wait_for()
            refusal = {
                "text": page.locator("#status").inner_text(),
                "contrast": page.evaluate(CONTRAST),
            }
            assert page.request.get(url + "api/config").status == 404
            browser.close()
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
        thread.join()
    assert not errors
    assert all(
        method == "GET" and address.startswith(url) for method, address in requests
    )
    record = {
        "captured_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "scope": "Actual static HTML/CSS/JS; existing recorded synthetic bundles only. No new inference, engine run or external system call.",
        "browser": "Chromium",
        "browser_version": browser_version,
        "stylesheet_sha256": digest(ROOT / "web/style.css"),
        "app_sha256": digest(ROOT / "web/app.js"),
        "gtm_sha256": digest(ROOT / "web/gtm.js"),
        "html_sha256": digest(ROOT / "web/index.html"),
        "catalog_sha256": digest(ROOT / "web/catalog.json"),
        "images": images,
        "reviews": reviews,
        "recorded_cases": catalog["scenarios"],
        "historical_images": {
            p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): digest(p)
            for p in sorted((ROOT / "docs/images/archive").glob("pre-navy-*.png"))
        },
        "refusal_state": refusal,
        "page_errors": errors,
        "network": "GET requests to loopback static server only",
        "interactions": [
            "case loading",
            "all four evidence tabs",
            "artifact validation",
            "keyboard tab navigation and visible focus",
            "exact-byte reproduction ZIP download",
            "reproduction commands with execution hidden",
            "invalid import refusal",
        ],
        "contrast_scope": "Computed text/solid-background checks; not a complete WCAG audit",
    }
    args.evidence.write_text(
        json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
    )
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "views": len(reviews),
                "overflow_failures": sum(r["overflow"] for r in reviews),
                "contrast_failures": sum(
                    len(r["contrast"]["failures"]) for r in reviews
                ),
                "images": list(images),
                "page_errors": errors,
            }
        )
    )
    assert not any(r["overflow"] or r["contrast"]["failures"] for r in reviews)
    assert not refusal["contrast"]["failures"]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Static packaging derives views from original artifacts; no independent business engine."""

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from .bundle import ROOT, verify, write_json

SCENARIOS = {
    "revenue-integrity": (
        "integrity", "Revenue Integrity: From Sales Commitment to Collected Cash",
        "Trace the $1,500 discrepancy, authoritative records and a separately reviewed delivery recovery. Recorded local execution; synthetic USD.",
    ),
    "release-assurance": (
        "release", "AI Model Release Assurance",
        "Inspect rejected model evaluations, finite-suite acceptance, actual local promotion and controlled-fault rollback.",
    ),
    "gtm-research": (
        "gtm", "SDR account intelligence · sources to seller review",
        "Prioritize six synthetic accounts, compare 40 actual Qwen3 responses and inspect a separately recorded local seller decision.",
    ),
    "gtm-enterprise": (
        "gtm", "120 accounts · USD $3.46M synthetic pipeline",
        "Inspect account qualification, exact approvals and five source CRM outcomes across treatment and holdout.",
    ),
    "gtm-salesforce": (
        "gtm", "Native Salesforce · one guarded SDR Task",
        "A separate Developer Edition run: Account/Contact resolution, ownership, lost-ack recovery and duplicate rollback.",
    ),
    "gtm-qwen": (
        "gtm", "Recorded Qwen3 · advice and refusal",
        "A separate 16-response evaluation preserves exact quotations, policy observations and six citation failures.",
    ),
    "connected-roundtrip": (
        "connected",
        "Salesforce and Snowflake round trip",
        "A governed CRM review survives a lost acknowledgment and changes the next warehouse decision.",
    ),
    "seller-application": (
        "seller",
        "Reviewed discovery action",
        "A saved model response was edited, approved and delivered to a synthetic CRM.",
    ),
    "seller-support-review": (
        "seller",
        "A passing draft with an unsupported claim",
        "Exact citations pass. The draft still implies unverified support availability.",
    ),
    "seller-stale": (
        "seller",
        "Evidence changes before approval",
        "The original Workbench refuses approval after new account evidence arrives.",
    ),
    "seller-suppressed": (
        "seller",
        "Consent blocks the action",
        "A recorded response is replayed; commercial authority prevents an effect.",
    ),
    "seller-live": (
        "seller",
        "Recorded fresh local inference",
        "A real local model produced this response; the original engine recorded the synthetic effect.",
    ),
    "seller-delivery": (
        "seller",
        "Saved response, fresh approved delivery",
        "Recorded response replay with original-engine approval and a new local receiver effect.",
    ),
    "control-recovery": (
        "control",
        "Uncertain delivery and recovery",
        "Durable intent, lost acknowledgments and independently observed receiver effects.",
    ),
    "revenue-bridge": (
        "revenue",
        "Installed ARR and quarterly flows",
        "Different economic measures reconcile at their own grain and time boundary.",
    ),
    "revenue-correction": (
        "revenue",
        "Late correction and equivalent rebuild",
        "Original dbt builds are compared with independently exported model rows.",
    ),
}


def build():
    catalog = []
    for path in sorted((ROOT / "web/evidence").glob("*/bundle.json")):
        verification = verify(path.parent)
        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text())
        scenario = manifest["scenario"]
        investigation, title, summary = SCENARIOS[scenario]
        write_json(path.parent / "verification.json", verification)
        portable = {
            "manifest": manifest,
            "artifacts": {
                # Preserve original line endings inside portable JSON. Text-mode
                # reads would normalize a Windows source artifact before hashing.
                a["path"]: (path.parent / a["path"]).read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
                for a in manifest["artifacts"]
            },
        }
        write_json(path.parent / "portable.json", portable)
        members = {"bundle.json": path.read_bytes(), **{
            a["path"]: (path.parent / a["path"]).read_bytes() for a in manifest["artifacts"]},
            "REPRODUCE.txt": (
                "Clone https://github.com/rlbsem/enterprise-revenue-systems-lab\nInstall requirements.lock and set PYTHONPATH=src.\n"
                + "\n".join(manifest["reproduce"])
                + "\npython -m revenue_lab.cli verify <extracted-bundle>\nRecorded inference is not reproducible byte-for-byte by a new model run.\n"
            ).encode()}
        archive = path.parent / "reproduction.zip"
        if archive.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("reproduction archive cannot be a symlink")
        unchanged = False
        if archive.exists():
            try:
                with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
                    unchanged = (len(z.namelist()) == len(members) and set(z.namelist()) == set(members)
                                 and all(z.read(name) == data for name, data in members.items()))
            except (zipfile.BadZipFile, OSError):
                pass
        # Preserve historical bytes when the content is identical. Repacking on
        # Linux would otherwise change Windows ZIP platform metadata and hashes.
        if not unchanged:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
                for name, data in members.items():
                    info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, date_time=(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
                    info.create_system = 3
                    info.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
                    info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
                    z.writestr(info, data)
        catalog.append(
            {
                "id": scenario,
                "investigation": investigation,
                "title": title,
                "summary": summary,
                "manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                "verification_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                    (path.parent / "verification.json").read_bytes()
                ).hexdigest(),
                "source": manifest["source"],
                "mode": manifest["mode"],
            }
        )
    write_json(ROOT / "web/catalog.json", {"version": 1, "scenarios": catalog})
    # Distribution is additive in an isolated build directory. No source or evidence deletion.
    shutil.copytree(ROOT / "web", ROOT / "dist", dirs_exist_ok=True)
    print(json.dumps({"scenarios": len(catalog), "output": str(ROOT / "dist")}))
